summary: TriLinc Global Impact Fund LLC filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, reporting portfolio liquidity progress and limited unit repurchases. Recent liquidation/settlement proceeds from investments Cevher and Dock Brasil prompted the Board to waive the DRP Proceeds Limitation for Q3 2026, funding about $2.5 million of pending death/disability repurchase requests at per-unit NAV as of June 30, 2026. Repurchases settle on or around September 30, 2026. The Board named no advisor. Regular repurchases and cash distributions remain suspended. Watch for further portfolio realizations, NAV marks, and any Board decision to resume distributions or broader repurchases.
